artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan inverting specs/ROADMAP.md into a wholly generated artifact backed by new roadmap_batches/roadmap_notes state.json entries, retiring the retention parser, and adding the /roadmap command, skill, and judgment-bearing agent.

memory_candidates.content: When a generated artifact retains hand-authored content by parsing it back out of the file its own generator is about to overwrite, the retention path silently freezes stale values forever: a value once rendered is read back as an 'authored override' and never re-derived from its source. Diagnose it cheaply by diffing the live file against the generator's no-retention print mode -- the divergence set is the frozen drift, and if (as measured here, 12 of 13 divergent lines) it consists of stale truncations rather than genuine prose, retiring the override field is a zero-loss net deletion that also repairs every frozen line. Invert such a generator by giving the authored content a structured home in the state the generator already reads, not by widening the parser.
